newsitem.title: USA: Hutchinson sees FY97 views "not far off".
newsitem.headline: Hutchinson sees FY97 views "not far off".

text.p: Hutchinson Technology Inc chief executive Wayne Fortun on Wednesday characterized Wall Street earnings per share estimates of $8.18 for fiscal year 1997 as "probably not far off".

"I always leave the predicting to those guys on earnings per share...we think they're probably not far off," he said in an interview before the company's annual shareholders meeting here in Minneapolis this afternoon.
Earnings per share for fiscal 1996 were $3.15 a share.
Fortun also said he expected at least a 20 percent increase in the company's shipments of suspension assemblies in fiscal 1997.
"We're anticipating a 20 percent-plus growth this year in volume," he said. Last year he said the company shipped 539 million suspension assembly units.
Suspension assemblies are the metal springs that hold the recording heads above the disks in computer disk drives.
Fortun said the company expects to have the capacity to produce two million to 2.5 million trace suspension assemblies per week by the end of 1997.
Hutchinson reported earnings for its first fiscal quarter ended December 31 of $1.97 a share versus $0.51 last year.
